title: Nine Winters and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：evening　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 evening 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my aunt ① spent an evening that no neighbour in the lane would have remembered, and she said the spending was the whole of the winter. The ② evening, meaning the hours themselves and not the morning, ran nine winters and stayed unremembered in the book; an evening, she said, is the only thing in a lane that is judged by how long it is left unremembered.

Every ③ evening in that lane had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ evening at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the visitors and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An evening, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to remember; my aunt said the remembering is the part that fills nine winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the evening was the whole of the visit, meaning the gathering and not the hours. The ⑥ evening, meaning the gathering and not any of that, is the only thing in a visit that everybody waits for and nobody remembers; evening, he said, is either something you spend or the only word that means both hours and a gathering. He said the gathering is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ evening had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ evening of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in January, was one lane and nine winters of remembering; evening, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to remember. She said the remembering was never mentioned.

The ⑨ evening I remember is the one remembered in the diary, which closed in 1968 and is still described as the quietest in the lane. An ⑩ evening, my mother said in 1970, is the only one that improves by being remembered; every evening, she said, is a gathering that has agreed to look like a few hours. She said the gathering was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 傍晚；晚上（指小巷里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 晚上（指那几个钟头本身，与上午相对）
C. 固定搭配：spend an evening 度过一个晚上
D. n. 晚上（指留给客人的那一个）
E. n. 晚上（抽象总称，指一条巷子里的夜晚之事）
F. n. 晚上（指日记上写到、被记起的那个）
G. n. 晚会；聚会（指一次串门里人人都等却无人记起的那样东西）
H. n. 聚会（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人记起的那样东西）

items.q: spent an evening that no neighbour in the lane would have remembered
The evening, meaning the hours themselves and not the morning
the evening at the far side
the evening was the whole of the visit
the evening had become a line in a diary
The evening of the whole thing
An evening, my mother said in 1970

answers.why: spend an evening 意为“度过一个晚上”，1957 年姑姑度过了一个小巷里没有一位邻居肯记起的晚上。
evening 意为“晚上”，指那几个钟头本身而不是上午，它经过了九个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
evening 意为“晚上”，指小巷里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一盏短短的灯。
evening 意为“晚上”，指留给客人的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
evening 意为“晚会、聚会”，指一次串门里人人都等却无人记起的那样东西，叔叔说这场聚会就是那次串门的全部。
evening 意为“聚会”，指人人都等却无人记起的那样东西而不是那几个钟头，是串门里人人都等、却无人记起的东西。
evening 意为“晚上”，指日记上写到、被记起的那个，到 1964 年这个晚上成了日记里的一行。
evening 意为“晚上”，姑姑一月写道，整件事的夜晚之事是一条巷子和九个冬天的记起。
evening 意为“晚上”，我记得的是日记上记起的那个，1968 年结束了，至今仍被说成巷子里最安静的一个。
evening 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，一个晚上是唯一会因为被好好记起而变得更好的东西。
